# Psalm 34 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A psalm of David, regarding the time he pretended to be insane in front of Abimelech, who sent him away.

**2** I will praise the LORD at all times. I will constantly speak His praises.

**3** I will boast only in the LORD; let all who are helpless take heart.

**4** Come, let us tell of the LORD's greatness; let us exalt His name together.

**5** I prayed to the LORD, and He answered me. He freed me from all my fears.

**6** Those who look to Him for help will be radiant with joy; no shadow of shame will darken their faces.

**7** In my desperation I prayed, and the LORD listened; He saved me from all my troubles.

**8** For the angel of the LORD is a guard; He surrounds and defends all who fear Him.

**9** Taste and see that the LORD is good. How happy are those who take refuge in Him!

**10** Fear the LORD, you His godly people, for those who fear Him will have all they need.

**11** Even strong young lions sometimes go hungry, but those who trust in the LORD will lack no good thing.

**12** Come, my children, and listen to me, and I will teach you to fear the LORD.

**13** Does anyone want to live a life that is long and prosperous?

**14** Then keep your tongue from speaking evil and your lips from telling lies!

**15** Turn away from evil and do good. Search for peace, and work to maintain it.

**16** The eyes of the LORD watch over those who do right; His ears are open to their cries for help.

**17** But the LORD turns His face against those who do evil; He will erase their memory from the earth.

**18** The LORD hears His people when they call to Him for help. He rescues them from all their troubles.

**19** The LORD is close to the brokenhearted; He rescues those whose spirits are crushed.

**20** The righteous person faces many troubles, but the LORD comes to the rescue each time.

**21** For the LORD protects the bones of the righteous; not one of them is broken!

**22** Calamity will surely destroy the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be punished.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **34:18**: One of the most comforting verses in Scripture. God does not merely observe the brokenhearted from afar — He draws near. Proximity is the promise.

— PNEUMA
